descriptor: Small team doing big things, shown in numbers

voice.summary: Sounds like a proud founder at a stand-up: big numbers, short sentences and a grin about the size of the team. The figures lead and the adjectives follow reluctantly.
dos: Put the number first and the unit straight after
Keep captions to a short phrase
Contrast small team with large impact once, then stop
donts: Do not inflate figures with maybes
Do not use more than one claim per number
Do not use filler like industry-leading

taglines: Numbers we're a little proud of
Count the impact, not the headcount
Big results from a small room
boilerplate: Smallfoot is a small team with an outsized reach, publishing its headline figures openly so partners and supporters can see exactly what the work has added up to.

microcopy.error: Figures couldn't load. Replay to try again.

logo.note: A single bold peak shows a small mark with a big footprint.
